# Kraft Mortgages Canada Inc.

> Kraft Mortgages Canada Inc. is a licensed Canadian mortgage brokerage headquartered in Surrey, BC, serving British Columbia, Alberta, and Ontario. Regulated across three provinces (BCFSA #SR220230 | RECA LIC-00655428 | FSRA #12918) with 18+ years of combined experience and $2B+ in funded mortgages across 5,000+ clients.

- Legal Name: Kraft Mortgages Canada Inc.

- Lender Access: 30+ A-lenders, B-lenders, Credit Unions, MICs, and Private Lenders
- Funded Volume: $2B+ CAD across 5,000+ funded mortgages

## Services
- Residential Mortgages (purchases, renewals, refinances, switches)
- Construction Financing (residential and commercial, progressive draw schedules)
- Commercial Mortgages (multi-family, retail, industrial, NOI/DSCR underwriting)
- Equity Lending (institutional alternative lenders — Antrim, Alta West, Vault, Sequence Capital)
- Private Lending (individual private lenders and MICs — 24-48h approvals)
- MLI Select Program (CMHC multi-unit insurance up to 95% LTV and 50-year amortization)
- Self-Employed / Stated-Income Mortgages (add-backs, business bank statements)
- Business Funding (working capital, lines of credit, equipment financing)
